description: Provisions: formation, use, release, re-measurement — and discounting. This is the one balance-sheet item a business must recognise for something that has NOT yet happened, which is why the law makes it a duty rather than an option: leaving it out overstates both the result and the equity, in the direction that flatters. summae had nothing at all — no account, no position, no operation, zero occurrences in either core. Four operations rather than one 'adjust', because there are four events and they mean different things: recognising is an expense for a future obligation; USING it is that obligation coming true; RELEASING it is the obligation going away, which is income the business never had to pay; RE-MEASURING is the estimate moving while the obligation stands. Netting them would produce a number that answers none of the questions an auditor asks — the same defect as reading a provision off an account balance. Two cases are worth reading closely. The overshoot: the invoice arrives at 6,500 against a provision of 5,000, so 5,000 comes out of the provision and 1,500 is an expense of the year the invoice arrived, NOT a retroactive correction of the year the provision was formed — netting those would move an expense across a closed year. And the discounting: the pack declares the RULE (from a remaining term of twelve months) and cites its basis, while the RATE arrives per act, because in Germany it is an average of seven years published monthly and a number in a pack file would be stale before anybody upgraded. A provision that must be discounted and carries no rate is refused by name rather than recognised undiscounted — a stale legal rate that looks authoritative is worse than an absent one. The compounding convention is stated rather than assumed: whole years compound, the stub months accrue simple interest, because a genuine fractional power is a transcendental and would put PHP and Node a cent apart.

expect.comment: Die Buchung ginge auf und stünde in der falschen Bilanzposition — dasselbe Argument wie beim Vorratskonto
Drei Jahre Restlaufzeit, also abzinsungspflichtig — und ohne Satz wird abgewiesen statt undiskontiert gebucht
Neun Monate Restlaufzeit: unter der Pack-Grenze, also gar keine Abzinsung
Die Rechnung ist höher als geschätzt: 5.000 aus der Rückstellung, 1.500 als Aufwand des laufenden Jahres — nicht rückwirkend gegen 2026
Neue Schätzung 8.000,00 auf zwei Jahre Restlaufzeit: 8.000,00 / 1,02² = 7.689,35; die Differenz zum Buchwert ist ein Ertrag unter dem Auflösungskonto
Mehr auflösen als die Rückstellung trägt wäre erfundener Ertrag
Ohne Betrag: der ganze Buchwert. Der Grund ist entfallen, das Geld musste nie gezahlt werden
Die Bewegungen sind der Punkt: verbraucht, neu bewertet und aufgelöst heißen Verschiedenes, und ein verrechneter Saldo zeigt keines davon

movements.note: settled at 6500.00, 1500.00 more than provided for
